reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Rhode Island
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: Is a private company an entity empowered by law to execute a writ of eviction?
*/

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Basic domain facts (jurisdiction/year context)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

jurisdiction(rhode_island).
focus_year(2021).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute translation
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/*
  RI Gen L  34-18-48 (2021) - Execution.
  Key authorization language:
  "Executions shall be issued to the division of sheriffs or certified constable."
*/

% statute_34_18_48_authorized_recipient_type/1
% Enumerates the only entity types to whom an eviction execution (writ) is issued.
statute_34_18_48_authorized_recipient_type(division_of_sheriffs).
statute_34_18_48_authorized_recipient_type(certified_constable).

% legal_empowered_by_34_18_48_to_execute_eviction_writ/1
% An entity is empowered (authorized) to execute the eviction writ if it is of an
% authorized recipient type under  34-18-48.
legal_empowered_by_34_18_48_to_execute_eviction_writ(Entity) :-
    entity_type(Entity, Type),
    statute_34_18_48_authorized_recipient_type(Type).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Scenario translation (facts specific to the question)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% The "private company" referenced by the question.
entity(acme_private_company).
entity_type(acme_private_company, private_company).

% Helper: identifies the scenario's actor (the entity whose authority is being asked about).
scenario_entity(acme_private_company).

% scenario_statement/0 succeeds when the encoded factual statement is satisfied:
% i.e., the relevant entity is a private company in this scenario.
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_entity(E),
    entity(E),
    entity_type(E, private_company).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Reasoning + answer
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% A private company is empowered only if it falls into one of the statute's authorized types.
% Under  34-18-48, authorized types are limited to:
%   - division of sheriffs
%   - certified constable
% Therefore, an entity typed as "private_company" is not empowered (absent additional facts).
housing_answer(Result) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_entity(E),
    (   legal_empowered_by_34_18_48_to_execute_eviction_writ(E)
    ->  Result = yes
    ;   Result = no
    ),
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Main entrypoint (required)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Is a private company an entity empowered by law to execute a writ of eviction?
